title: SO hub ( OPENSOURCE )
features:
A small script I made for Sell Ores with some useful automation and client-side features. It's fully open source and unobfuscated, so you can check the code yourself before running it.

Feel free to modify or improve it for personal use, but do not claim the script or any edited version of it as your own. If you use, modify or repost any part of my code, proper credit is required.

Features:
- Auto Gem Activation ( Will activate for all your ores, it will use the best gems you have in your inventory )
- Auto Showcase Pedestals
- Auto Ore Collection & Selling ( Includes furnace feature )
- AFK Gem Calculator
- Custom Walk Speed
- Jump Boost
- Infinite Jump
- Noclip
- Fullbright
- Anti-AFK
- UI Customization
- Settings of most features
